title: The Quarry's Den
text: The den is empty: a hollow of trampled earth, bones gnawed clean, a nest of fur and feathers. In the middle lies what it was guarding, small and alive and mewling. Far off through the trees, something answers.

options.label: The Leader takes the young; its bones will fetch a fine price.

outcomes.text: The quarry will come for it soon, and from behind.

options.label: Wait in the den for the parent, and meet it on ground of your choosing.

outcomes.text: It comes home to find you there. It is angry.

options.label: The gentlest leaves the young unharmed, hoping the parent remembers.

outcomes.text: The quarry finds its young whole and is slower to fight. You are glad of it.
